title: Sajjad bhi ummul masayab bhi
body:
Haye Zainab  Haye Bazar Haye Sajjad ...(3)
Bazar mai itni der chale Sajjad bhi Umul Masayab bhi ...(2)
Bas lashon mai tabdeel hue Sajjad bhi Umul masayab bhi...(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Kuch zakhom ki tadad nhi bazar se sar e pau tak..(2)
Apne hi khoo'n..(2) mai hain dubay Sajjad bhi Umul masayab bhi
Bazar mai itni der chale Sajjad bhi Umul Masayab bhi...(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Ab khudbay ain zarori thy khamosh bhala kab tk rehte..(2)
Bhagi bhagi..(2) sunte sunte Sajjad  bhi Umul Masayab  bhi
Bazar mai itni der chale Sajjad bhi Umul Masayab bhi...(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Kabhi girte thy kabhi uthty thy kar har bazar abur gae...(2)
Diwaron se..(2) lagte lagte Sajjad  bhi Umul Masayab  bhi
Bazar mai itni der chale Sajjad bhi Umul Masayab bhi...(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Kai lakh ne inko mara hai har gham pe apni marzi se...(2)
Yun ghurbat ki..(2) tasweer bany Sajjad  bhi Umul Masayab  bhi
Bazar mai itni der chale Sajjad bhi Umul Masayab bhi...(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Har shami zulm bharhata tha khush hokar jashan manata tha...(2)
Girte thy jab..(2) chalty chalty Sajjad  bhi Umul Masayab  bhi
Bazar mai itni der chale Sajjad bhi Umul Masayab bhi...(3)
